# `/discovered-applications` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /discovered-applications/v1

`getDiscoveredApplicationsV1` — Get discovered applications for tenant

Get a list of applications that have been identified within the environment. This includes details such as application names, discovery dates, potential correlated saas_vendors and related suggested connectors.

- Scopes: idn:application-discovery:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `detail` (query) — one of SLIM, FULL — Determines whether slim, or increased level of detail is provided for each discovered application in the returned list. SLIM is the default behavior.
  - `filter` (query) — Filter results using the standard syntax described in [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters#filtering-results) Filtering is…
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: name, description, discoveredAt, discoverySource, discoverySourceName, discoverySourceCategory — e.g. `name`
- Returns 200: array of object
